gaps.name: Missing Temperature Dependency in Circuit Model
gaps.impact: CircuitComponent did not carry temperature coefficient alpha or reference temperature T_ref, preventing resistance updating during simulation.
gaps.resolution: Extend CircuitComponent or provide ElectrothermalCouplingContract with temperature coefficient alpha, T_ref, and spatial footprint mapping.

gaps.name: Absence of Fixed-Point Co-Simulation Loop
gaps.impact: Electrical and thermal domains were solved in complete isolation or in a single forward pass without feedback.
gaps.resolution: Construct ElectrothermalSolver that iteratively exchanges power losses and temperatures until residuals satisfy stopping criteria.

gaps.name: Numerical Instability in High Heat Flux Regimes
gaps.impact: Without under-relaxation, steep positive temperature coefficients can cause fixed-voltage or fixed-current iterations to ping-pong or diverge.
gaps.resolution: Implement under-relaxation theta in (0, 1] applied to either heat source updates or temperature field updates.

gaps.name: Lack of Explicit Cross-Domain Energy Balance Audit
gaps.impact: Potential divergence or non-physical power leaks go undetected.
gaps.resolution: Compute total electrical power generated P_elec = sum(V_i * I_i) and total thermal heat flux Q_out = sum(Q_conv) + sum(Q_sink), verifying |P_elec - Q_out| / P_elec <= 1e-3.
